shared_elements: upright grey stone monument displayed on a plinth/museum floor
shallow incised/low-relief curvilinear ornament on a stone surface
paired curved bands framing the design
vertical linear ridges or grooves near the top edge
justification: Both are upright grey stone blocks bearing shallow incised curvilinear motifs, and each has a roughly central concentric circle/disc flanked or bounded by sweeping curved bands, plus banded linear detail near the top. But A is a flat, flaring slab whose crisp double spirals and fish-like creature fill a bordered panel, whereas B is a bulky three-dimensional carved figure with faint, worn, scattered marks that follow the body's contours rather than a framed composition.
